Open [Settings](https://smithers.sh/app/settings). Your model is personal; deployment controls appear for an Admin.

## Your model

Members and above can save their own model keys. Under **Your model**, enter the provider's **Base URL** and **Key** for an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible API.

Choose the model and key for each tier:

| Tier | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| Fast | Chat, generated views, judgments and summaries |
| Implement | Coding |
| Hard | Plans and reviews |

Choose **Save**, then **Test** to check the saved configuration. Keys are never displayed. An empty Key keeps the saved key at that Base URL; clearing the Base URL removes it. **Remove** deletes your saved configuration.

Calls use your configured models and your provider's billing, outside the deployment's daily model budget. A rejected key or exhausted provider quota appears as a failure; Smithers does not silently switch to the deployment's model.

## Spend alerts

An Admin can set **Email** recipients and a **Telegram chat** under **Spend alerts**. Save each channel separately; an empty field turns that channel off. Delivery receipts show **Sent**, **Retrying** or **Refused** with the reason. Model spend appears in Admin notifications.

## Sandboxes

An Admin sets **Awake**, **Awake per person** and **Monthly alert ($)** under **Sandboxes**, then chooses **Save**.

Defaults are 20 awake across the deployment, 2 per person and a $100 monthly alert. A sandbox that would exceed an awake limit waits for capacity. Setting the monthly alert to $0 turns that alert off; it does not cap spending. **Saving** or **Not saved** means the update has not landed.

Operators can also configure [deployment limits](/docs/operator/).
